title: Supporting the Rehabilitation of Kalimantan’s Orangutans, Feed Assistance Delivered through YIARI
excerpt: Relawan Nusantara delivered feed assistance through YIARI to support the rehabilitation of Kalimantan orangutans affected by forest fires. Read the full story!
seoTitle: Feed Aid for Kalimantan Orangutan Rehab via YIARI - Relawan Nusantara
seoDescription: Relawan Nusantara delivered feed assistance through YIARI to support the rehabilitation of Kalimantan orangutans affected by forest fires. Read more!
html:
Behind the richness of Kalimantan’s forests lives wildlife that depends on the preservation of its habitat. Forest fires, however, can wipe out the animals’ homes and food sources, leaving them in need of care and rehabilitation in order to recover.

Through the Peduli Satwa Kalimantan (Care for Kalimantan’s Wildlife) Program, Relawan Nusantara delivered animal feed assistance to Yayasan Inisiasi Alam Rehabilitasi Indonesia (YIARI) as an expression of kind-hearted people’s care for wildlife in need of support, particularly orangutans undergoing rehabilitation.

Feed Assistance to Support Wildlife Rehabilitation

The feed assistance was symbolically handed over to YIARI through its orangutan rescue and conservation center. It is hoped that this assistance will help meet the feed needs of animals receiving care following their rescue (rescue).

Dr. Gina expressed her thanks to all the kind-hearted people who have entrusted their care through Relawan Nusantara to help meet the animals’ feed needs.

She also explained that the animals, especially orangutans, still need care and rehabilitation. Forest fires that damage their natural habitat leave them without a home and the environment where they forage, making recovery efforts an important part of safeguarding their survival.

The impact of forest fires is felt not only by people, but also by wildlife that loses its shelter and food sources. For that reason, supporting wildlife rescue and rehabilitation centers is one of the ways to help these animals get the care they need.

A Shared Commitment to Preserving Nature

For animals undergoing rehabilitation, meeting their feed needs is an important part of the care process. Through the assistance delivered to YIARI, it is hoped that the donors’ care will bring real benefit to animals in need.

Thank you to all the kind-hearted people who have taken part in the Peduli Satwa Kalimantan Program. Every kindness entrusted is an expression of care for the lives of wild animals as well as support for efforts to preserve nature.

May every bit of feed given bring benefit, every act of care become hope, and every small step be a real contribution to the preservation of Indonesia’s wildlife.

Because caring for wildlife is part of the effort to safeguard life and preserve nature. Let us take a real role in safeguarding the preservation and welfare of wildlife in Kalimantan. We protect nature, nature protects us.

Luaskan Manfaat
